rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something turned out fortunately or luckily.

example.english: Fortunately, I made it in time for the last train.
example.jyutping: hou2 coi2 ngo5 gon2 dak1 cit3 mei5 baan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that a bad outcome was avoided or that a favorable fact came to the rescue.

example.english: Fortunately, you brought an umbrella; otherwise we'd be soaked.
example.traditional: 好在你帶咗遮，唔係我哋就濕晒。
example.jyutping: hou2 zoi6 nei5 daai3 zo2 ze1 m4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zau6 sap1 saai3

rows.note: Use this as a more formal or written equivalent of 好彩 for saying that it was fortunate that something happened.

example.english: Fortunately, no one was injured in the accident.
example.jyutping: hang6 hou2 si6 gu3 zung1 mou4 jan4 sau6 soeng1

rows.note: Use this written adverb when describing an outcome as occurring in a fortunate manner rather than giving a conversational reaction.

example.english: Fortunately, the project was completed smoothly in the end.
example.traditional: 幸運地，計劃最終順利完成。
example.jyutping: hang6 wan6 dei6 gai3 waak6 zeoi3 zung1 seon6 lei6 jyun4 sing4
